data.name: Khalidah
data.gender_notes: Khalidah is used as a girl/boy name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khalidah is an Islamic name for girls and boys, derived from the Arabic word 'khalid', which means 'eternal'. It signifies immortality, continuity, and endurance. The name Khalidah carries the meaning “Eternal” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Khalidah usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: As an eternal being, a Khalidah embodies the divine attribute of being everlasting, reflecting the timeless nature of the universe and the soul's journey towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Khalidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khalidah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
